purpose: Phase-7C immune-escape abstraction - DISTINCT from immune suppression. Suppression = reduced immune effectiveness; escape = the tumour's modelled ability to avoid / resist / bypass immune recognition and elimination. Phase 7C keeps escape a MICROENVIRONMENTAL + FUNCTIONAL abstraction; it does NOT infer acquired genetic immune escape (Phase 8A may later interpret persistent, treatment-associated escape as resistance-related - Phase 7C does not). Section 1 establishes the contract; calculation is a later section (UNAVAILABLE for now). Schematic normalized [0,1].

coefficient_policy.source: general tumour immune-evasion biology applied predictively
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: persistent_escape requires prior-frame persistence (temporal), not a single frame; it is the observation Phase 8A may later read.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No genetic immune-escape mutation is inferred (excluded); microenvironmental/functional abstraction only.

rules.distinct_from_suppression: escape is computed as its own metric, not a rename of total suppression.
rules.no_genetic_escape: no acquired genetic immune-escape mechanism is fabricated; persistence is a functional observation only.
rules.phase8a_interpretation: Phase 7C publishes persistent-escape observations; Phase 8A owns any resistance interpretation of them.
